frontmatter.name: rbac-rules-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews changes to eha-transfer's access control (firestore.rules, Firestore queries in src/contexts/DataContext.tsx, roles in src/types, permission helpers in src/lib, and role-gated UI) against the app's actual role and facility model.
